name: Pennant International Group plc
summary: Pennant International Group plc, through its subsidiaries, provides integrated training and support solutions, products, and services in the United Kingdom, Europe, the Middle East, North America, and Australasia. The company offers generic training equipment, including hydraulic systems, generic flying controls, generic hand skill, integrated maintenance, and basic flying control rod and helicopter maintenance trainers, as well as wiring board for use in aeronautical engineering colleges and academies. It also provides virtual reality solutions, which include virtual parachute training simulator, synthetic environment procedural and cargo compartment trainers, virtual reality shunter trainer, and virtual loadmaster training systems; Web and server-based e-learning, computer-based training, and computer aided instruction applications; engineering solutions; simulators and emulators for recruits to train on equipment or systems; and software development services. It primarily serves defense, rail, aerospace, and naval sectors, as well as government departments. Pennant International Group plc was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Cheltenham, the United Kingdom.
